compatibility_badge: PCB Layout Change Required (Pinout or Package Mismatch)

pin_diff.note: PINOUT CONFLICT on Pin 1: LMV321IDBVR assigns 1IN+ (IN_POS) whereas TLV9001IDBVR assigns OUT (OUT) — direct drop-in risks rail short or IC destruction.
Functionally identical VEE pin (GND vs V-).
PINOUT CONFLICT on Pin 3: LMV321IDBVR assigns 1IN- (IN_NEG) whereas TLV9001IDBVR assigns IN+ (IN_POS) — direct drop-in risks rail short or IC destruction.
PINOUT CONFLICT on Pin 4: LMV321IDBVR assigns OUT (OUT) whereas TLV9001IDBVR assigns IN- (IN_NEG) — direct drop-in risks rail short or IC destruction.
Functionally identical VCC pin (VCC+ vs V+).

parameter_matrix.note: Op-amps (internally compensated for linear feedback) and comparators (uncompensated open-loop switching) are NOT drop-in interchangeable.
Single SOT-23-5 op-amps vary in pin ordering across vendors; verify Pin 1–5.

Controls large-signal full-power bandwidth SR / (2π·Vpeak) or comparator switching speed.

swap_risks: CRITICAL PINOUT CONFLICT: Incompatible pin assignments on Pin 1 (IN_POS vs OUT), Pin 3 (IN_NEG vs IN_POS), Pin 4 (OUT vs IN_NEG). Soldering TLV9001IDBVR onto a LMV321IDBVR footprint (or vice versa) without rerouting copper can short VIN/VOUT/GND and permanently damage the board.

HIGH HEADROOM / CLIPPING RISK: Rail-to-rail capability differs (LMV321IDBVR: IN=Non-RR, OUT=RR vs TLV9001IDBVR: IN=RR, OUT=RR); verify input common-mode range (Vicm) and output voltage swing against ADC full-scale range.

HIGH INPUT BIAS CURRENT SHIFT: Typical Ib differs by 3000x (LMV321IDBVR: 15000 pA p.7 vs TLV9001IDBVR: 5 pA p.17); high-impedance sensor dividers (>100 kΩ) suffer severe Ib·R DC offset error when swapping from CMOS/JFET to bipolar inputs.

CAUTION QUIESCENT CURRENT SHIFT: Supply current per channel differs by 2.2x (LMV321IDBVR: 130 µA/ch p.7 vs TLV9001IDBVR: 60 µA/ch p.18); verify battery budget and total power dissipation across all channels.
HIGH ABSOLUTE-MAX SURGE MARGIN: LMV321IDBVR has a lower Vs,abs,max rating (5.5 V, p.5) than TLV9001IDBVR (7 V, p.14); verify hot-plug, inductive kickback, and TVS clamp peaks stay safely below 5.5 V.
HIGH MINIMUM SUPPLY FLOOR: LMV321IDBVR requires Vs,min >= 2.7 V (p.5) vs 1.8 V on the counterpart; confirm low-battery / brown-out operation still clears the higher floor.
engineering_verdict: LMV321IDBVR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-5) and TLV9001IDBVR (Texas Instruments, SOT-23-5) are NOT drop-in interchangeable (Level 3 PCB Layout / Circuit Change Required) due to pinout mismatch on Pin 1 (IN_POS vs OUT), Pin 3 (IN_NEG vs IN_POS), Pin 4 (OUT vs IN_NEG). Specific pin conflicts: Pin 1 (IN_POS vs OUT), Pin 3 (IN_NEG vs IN_POS), Pin 4 (OUT vs IN_NEG). Signal-chain deltas: GBWP 1 MHz (p.7) vs 1 MHz (p.17), supply ceiling 5.5 V (p.5) vs 5.5 V (p.14), Vos 7 mV (p.7) vs 1.6 mV (p.17), Ib 3000x gap (15000 vs 5 pA), voltage noise 39 vs 30 nV/√Hz. Primary bench gotchas to watch: LMV321IDBVR "CRITICAL SOT-23-5 Pinout Mismatch vs TLV9001IDBVR, TLV9061IDBVR, OPA333AIDBVR, and TLV3201AIDBVR" (p.3) and TLV9001IDBVR "Critical SOT-23-5 Suffix Trap: TLV9001IDBVR vs TLV9001UIDBVR Pinout Swap" (p.7). BOM decision: Choose LMV321IDBVR when matching your existing Texas Instruments SOT-23-5 (DBV) qualification and -40..125 °C grade; choose TLV9001IDBVR when DC precision demands <= 1.6 mV max Vos or high-impedance sensors require pA-class input bias (5 pA). Always verify Pin 1 orientation (TOP_VIEW p.3 vs TOP_VIEW p.7) and official datasheets on hardware prototypes prior to production.
